name: Onboarding Carousel
description: A three-slide React Native onboarding for a habit app: drawn poster illustrations, colour that blends as you swipe and a Next button that grows into Get started.

props.name: slides
props.description: Kicker, title, body, background, accent and art (seed | chain | steps) per slide.

props.name: finishLabel
props.description: Label on the final pill button.

props.name: onFinish
props.description: Called by Get started, or Skip on the last slide.
